prompt: Provide a brief description of object-oriented polymorphism. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use verbs. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as a semicolon-delimited single line.
response_text: A mechanism where different classes share a common interface; same operation yields varied implementations; inheritance or interfaces enable diverse behavior under unified naming; runtime binding determines exact execution path; dynamic method resolution allows flexible responses to identical calls.
